en-US.description: Universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.
en-US.longDescription:
opencodex is a universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and Grok Build: a local proxy that lets them run on many different LLM providers from a single port, translating between API wire formats.

Features:
- Works with Anthropic, Google, xAI, Groq, OpenRouter, Azure, DeepSeek, Ollama, and 40+ other built-in providers.
- Supports streaming, tool calls, reasoning, and images.
- Handles OAuth logins and a ChatGPT account pool.
- Native model picker in the Codex app, sub-agents, and search/vision sidecars.

Published to npm as @bitkyc08/opencodex@2.99.0 with dist-tag latest.
New Features
- Count streamed tool argument bytes incrementally (#8140)
- Add opt-in stored Codex turn reply reads (#8053)
- Measure fragmented NDJSON incrementally (#8277)
Bug Fixes
- Ship per-model effort ladders and fold native Chat ultra (#8259)
- Bound Windows overflow slices and preserve child cleanup (#8229)
- Hedge leftover-pin refusal and count in-flight readiness reads (#8261)
- Bound tool-call validation and document request limits (#8147)
- Preserve mandatory tool choices through routing and recovery (#8146)
- Preserve late Devin signatures for DSH clients (#8230)
- Batch affinity writes and confirm operator resets (#8020)
- Enforce root send ceilings at physical admission (#8149)
- Fix dashboard switch and combo layout regressions (#8269)
- Fix clipped Models rows and dashboard control layout (#8272)
- Accept unambiguous selected tool aliases (#8235)
- Sanitize Chat fields and normalize native thinking content (#8278)
- Fix omitted effort on dual-control Chat wires (#8279)
- Honor max omission before native ultra clamping (#8284)
- Align macOS traffic lights on Sequoia and keep chips rounded in WKWebView (#8285)
- Fix launcher signal race and chat-completions network flake (#8289)
- Keep masked account label validation linear (#8316)
Chores
- Stabilize Windows fixture setup and source checks (#8176)
- Isolate Codex CLI update fixture process scans (#8283)
- Include uninstall refusal reason in regression output (#8242)
Other Changes
- Open dev at 2.99.0 before releasing 2.98.0 (#8263)
- Clarify Desktop startup safety and mask OAuth account labels (#8271)
- Show app breakdowns and client chips (#8282)
- Promote frozen tip de411020ed to main as 2.99.0 (#8322)

zh-CN.description: OpenAI Codex 与 Claude Code 的通用提供商代理。
zh-CN.longDescription:
opencodex 是面向 OpenAI Codex、Claude Code、Claude Desktop 和 Grok Build 的通用提供商代理：一个本地代理，让它们通过单一端口运行在多种不同的大模型提供商上，并在 API 协议格式之间进行转换。

特性：
- 支持 Anthropic、Google、xAI、Groq、OpenRouter、Azure、DeepSeek、Ollama 等 40 多个内置提供商。
- 支持流式输出、工具调用、推理和图像。
- 处理 OAuth 登录和 ChatGPT 账号池。
- Codex 应用内的原生模型选择器、子智能体，以及搜索/视觉辅助功能。
